summary: 47-year-old Boulder man on a solo backcountry ski from the Yule Creek trailhead near McClure Pass got lost in the Raggeds Wilderness; spent ~28 hours covering ~18 miles and self-rescued at Ericson Springs campground near Marble with only minor frostbite to fingers and toes; West Elk SAR, Mountain Rescue Aspen, and Crested Butte SAR searched Sunday before the search was called off
location: Yule Creek trailhead, McClure Pass; Raggeds Wilderness; emerged at Ericson Springs campground, Marble
responding_agency: West Elk Search and Rescue; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Crested Butte Search and Rescue
notes: Left Saturday morning 2018-01-20; friends reported him missing 9 p.m. Saturday; followed wrong ski tracks off his typical descent into unfamiliar terrain; survived the night wrapped in a space blanket; row date = search/emergence day 2018-01-21 (Sunday, weekday-verified); article published 2018-01-24.
